Product: CloudSync Pro - Enterprise file synchronization and backup solution. Version 5.2.1 (latest). Platforms: Windows 10/11, macOS 12+, iOS 15+, Android 11+, Web app. License types: Personal ($9.99/month), Team ($19.99/user/month), Enterprise (contact sales).

Installation - Windows: Download installer from cloudsync.com/download. Run CloudSyncSetup.exe as administrator. Follow installation wizard. Minimum requirements: Windows 10 (64-bit), 4GB RAM, 500MB disk space. Restart may be required.

Installation - macOS: Download DMG from cloudsync.com/download. Open DMG and drag CloudSync to Applications folder. First launch requires Security approval in System Preferences > Privacy. Minimum requirements: macOS 12 Monterey or later, 4GB RAM, 500MB disk space.

Installation - Mobile: Download from App Store (iOS) or Google Play Store (Android). Sign in with your CloudSync account. Grant permissions for storage access and notifications. Background sync requires battery optimization to be disabled on Android.

Account Setup: Create account at cloudsync.com/signup. Verify email within 24 hours. Set up two-factor authentication (recommended). Free trial: 14 days full access. No credit card required for trial.

Two-Factor Authentication: Enable in Account Settings > Security. Options: Authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy), SMS code, or hardware key (FIDO2). Backup codes provided - store securely. Required for Enterprise accounts.

Sync Not Working - Basic Troubleshooting: 1. Check internet connection. 2. Verify you're signed in (click tray icon). 3. Check sync status icon (green = synced, blue = syncing, red = error). 4. Right-click tray icon > Sync Now to force sync. 5. Check available disk space.

Sync Not Working - Advanced: 1. Check firewall isn't blocking CloudSync (port 443). 2. Disable VPN temporarily to test. 3. Clear sync cache: Settings > Advanced > Clear Cache. 4. Check sync folder location is accessible. 5. Review sync log: Help > View Logs.

Sync Conflicts: When same file edited on multiple devices, CloudSync creates conflict copy. Conflict files named 'filename (Conflict from Device on Date).ext'. Compare versions and keep preferred one. Delete conflict copy when resolved. Enable real-time sync to minimize conflicts.

Selective Sync: Choose which folders sync to each device. Settings > Selective Sync. Useful for saving space on laptops. Unsynced folders remain in cloud, accessible via web. Changes take effect immediately.

File Sharing - Internal: Right-click file/folder > Share. Enter teammate's email. Permission levels: View, Edit, Admin. Link sharing for teams. Notifications sent automatically. Revoke access anytime.

File Sharing - External: Create shared link for anyone. Options: password protection, expiration date, download limits. External sharing may be disabled by admin (Enterprise). Links can be revoked anytime.

Version History: All file versions saved for 30 days (Personal), 180 days (Team/Enterprise). Access: Right-click file > Version History. Preview previous versions. Restore any version with one click. Deleted files recoverable from Trash for same period.

Storage Limits: Personal: 1TB. Team: 2TB per user. Enterprise: Unlimited. Check usage: Account Settings > Storage. Upgrade anytime. Downgrade takes effect at next billing cycle. Files aren't deleted if you exceed limit, but sync pauses.
Upload/Download Speed: Default: Automatic (uses available bandwidth). Limit speeds: Settings > Bandwidth. Schedule limits for work hours. Pause sync: Click tray icon > Pause Syncing. Resume anytime.

Offline Access: Mark files/folders for offline access on mobile. Right-click > Make Available Offline. Offline files sync when connection restored. Storage required on device. Smart Sync (Team/Enterprise) downloads files on demand.

Error: Not Enough Disk Space: Free up local disk space. Use Selective Sync to reduce synced folders. Enable Smart Sync (Team/Enterprise) to store files online only. Move sync folder to drive with more space: Settings > Sync Folder Location.
Error: File Too Large: Maximum file size: 50GB. Split large files into smaller parts. Use CloudSync for backup instead. Contact support for Enterprise large file solutions.
Error: File Name Not Supported: Invalid characters: \ / : * ? " < > |. File name too long: max 255 characters (including path). Reserved names: CON, PRN, AUX, NUL on Windows. Rename file to resolve.

Error: Permission Denied: Check file isn't open in another app. Verify file/folder permissions on OS level. Run CloudSync as administrator (Windows). Check antivirus isn't blocking access. Restart CloudSync.

Error: Certificate Error: Check system date/time is correct. Update CloudSync to latest version. Corporate networks may require proxy/certificate configuration. Contact IT administrator for Enterprise deployments.

Backup Feature: Automatic backup of selected folders. Backup schedule: continuous, hourly, or daily. Backup retained even if original deleted. Restore from Settings > Backup > Restore. Not included in sync - one-way upload only.

Team Administration: Admin Console at admin.cloudsync.com. Manage users, groups, permissions. View activity logs. Set sharing policies. Remote wipe lost devices. SSO configuration available (Enterprise).

SSO Integration: Supported providers: Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, OneLogin. SAML 2.0 protocol. Configure in Admin Console > Security > SSO. Test before enabling for all users. Fallback password option available.

API Access: REST API for developers. Documentation at developers.cloudsync.com. API key in Account Settings > Developers. Rate limits: 1000 requests/hour (Personal), 10000/hour (Team), unlimited (Enterprise). SDKs available for Python, JavaScript, Java.
Mobile App - Photo Backup: Auto-upload photos and videos. Settings > Camera Upload. Choose WiFi-only or include cellular. Original quality or space-saving compression. Organize by date automatically.
Mobile App - Offline Files: Star files for offline access. Limited by device storage. Auto-remove old offline files: Settings > Storage Management. Offline edits sync when online.

Desktop App - System Tray: Right-click for quick actions. Green checkmark = all synced. Blue arrows = sync in progress. Red X = sync error (click for details). Pause/resume sync. Open sync folder. Access recent files.
Desktop App - Context Menu: Right-click files in Explorer/Finder. Share, copy link, view history. Make available offline. See sync status. Open in web browser.

Privacy and Security: End-to-end encryption optional (Enterprise). AES-256 encryption at rest. TLS 1.3 in transit. Zero-knowledge option available. SOC 2 Type II certified. GDPR compliant. HIPAA compliant (Enterprise with BAA).

Contact Support: Email: support@cloudsync.com (response within 24 hours). Live chat: Available 9am-6pm EST weekdays. Phone: 1-800-CLOUDSYNC (Enterprise only). Help Center: help.cloudsync.com. Community forum: community.cloudsync.com.

Billing: View invoices in Account Settings > Billing. Update payment method anytime. Cancel subscription from same page. Prorated refunds for annual plans cancelled within 30 days. No refunds for monthly plans.
Data Export: Download all your data: Account Settings > Privacy > Export Data. Includes files, settings, activity log. ZIP file ready within 24 hours. Link expires in 7 days.
